settings.heading: Fully customizable
settings.row_content: A SHAMBALLA®creation is meant to travel with you for a life time. You can build your SHAMBALLA®design bead by bead entirely from scratch, which allows you to encapsulate every important milestone in the design.Choose from the vast component catalogue rich in a variety gemstones and string colors and let only your imagination set the limits.

settings.heading: Worldwide Shipping
settings.row_content:
Shamballa Jewels orders are delivered Monday to Friday between 9am and 5pm, subject to local delivery. As every order is unique, shipping costs will vary depending on the size, weight and destination of your chosen items. All orders use Express delivery through UPS, DHL or FedEx.

We will choose the most efficient express service for your location.
Courier services used: DHL EXPRESS, UPS EXPRESS SAVER, FedEx Expedited, Der Kurier. 

Delivery time:
Up to 4-6 weeks 

Transit times:
Europe: delivery within 1-2 business days
USA: delivery within 2-3 days
Rest of the world: delivery within 2-7 days

Please keep in mind that our shipping times should be used as a guide only and are based on time from dispatch. Shamballa Jewels cannot take responsibility for customs clearance delays or failed payment approval, though we will try to minimize any potential delays.

settings.heading: Easy Return or Exchange
settings.row_content:
If you’re looking to return or exchange your order for whatever reason, we're here to help! We offer returns or exchanges within 14 days of receiving your order. You can return your product for a different product, or a refund to the original payment method.

For more information please check our return policy

settings.heading: Flip Lock Cuff from Shamballa Jewels

settings.text:
Flip Lock Cuff from Shamballa Jewels
Discover the stylish elegance of the Flip Lock Cuff from Shamballa Jewels – a unique piece of jewelry that combines functionality with luxurious design. This collection is created for those who wish to express their personal style with a piece that is both eye-catching and practical. Each Flip Lock Cuff is designed with a focus on quality and detail, making it an essential part of any jewelry collection.

Innovative Design
The Flip Lock Cuff is characterized by its modern and unique design. The innovative locking mechanism provides a secure and stylish look that sets it apart from traditional bracelets. This piece is perfect for both everyday wear and festive occasions, making it a versatile addition to your wardrobe. Whether worn alone or layered with other jewelry, the Flip Lock Cuff will add a refined touch to your look.

High-Quality Materials
Each Flip Lock Cuff is made from exclusive materials, including 18-karat gold, rose gold, white gold, and black rhodinated gold. These luxurious materials ensure that each cuff not only looks fantastic but is also designed to maintain its beauty over the years. The quality and durability of our cuffs allow you to wear them with pride, regardless of the occasion.

Adorned with Diamonds and Gemstones
To add an extra level of glamour, the Flip Lock Cuff can be embellished with diamonds and colorful gemstones. These sparkling details make each cuff a unique piece of jewelry that can celebrate the most important moments in your life. Whether you choose a simple version or one with diamonds, the Flip Lock Cuff will be a statement piece that stands out.

Perfect for Any Occasion
The Flip Lock Cuff is designed for both men and women who want to express their style with exclusive jewelry. Whether you are attending a formal event or looking to elevate your everyday look, this piece is the ideal choice. It can be worn alone for an elegant expression or styled together with other jewelry to create a personal style.

Explore the Flip Lock Cuff
We invite you to discover the Flip Lock Cuff in our store or online. Our dedicated team is ready to help you find the perfect cuff that matches your style and occasion. Experience the unique beauty and quality of Shamballa Jewels’ Flip Lock Cuff and add a luxurious touch to your jewelry collection.
